name: The Glass Herald
_doc: Expansion 1 (Vharlen). The ZONE EVENT BOSS for Glasswind Strand: the herald of the Glass Kings walks out of the tomb to proclaim a king who has been dead for three hundred years. P1 'The Proclamation': a staff cone, decrees cut in three lines, and the Proclamation itself — a blast across the whole ruin; hide behind a glass obelisk. P2 at 55% 'The Glass Court': the herald stands behind a ward of light while the court gathers — TURN ALL THREE SUN MIRRORS onto it (use them) to shatter the ward. P3, a new health bar 'Shattered Herald': shards ride every player, a kneel-together stack, a get-in-close ring and a turning cross. Soft enrage from 4 minutes, hard at 7. OWNER #51 (2026-10-15): the phase that refilled the health bar is removed; the health bar is the whole fight.
party: Zone event, everyone nearby joins. Solo: not intended (three mirrors under adds, a stack that needs 3). 3-5: playable. 10+: intended. M5 scaling: health and court adds by players enrolled; stack need = clamp(players/4, 2, 5).

pull: HEAR ME. THE GLASS KING RETURNS. KNEEL.
A tall figure of clear glass walks out of the tomb, ringing a bell.
By order of the Glass King, this strand is closed to the living.
say.death: The Glass Herald rings his bell once more. It cracks. So does he.
say.reset: The Glass Herald walks back into the tomb, still proclaiming.

enrage.say: THE KING HAS LOST HIS PATIENCE. KNEEL OR SHATTER.

soft.say: The light through the Herald grows harsher.

decree.name: Glass Decree
decree.say: The Herald reads a decree — three lines of cutting light!

proclaim.name: The Proclamation
proclaim.say: HEAR THE PROCLAMATION! Get behind a glass obelisk!

court.name: The Court Gathers
court.say: More of the court crawls out of the glass!

glass_rain.name: Glass Rain
glass_rain.say: Glass rains down — and the shards stay where they fall!

phases.name: The Glass Court
phases.say: THE COURT WILL ATTEND. ALL OF IT.

ward.say: The Herald stands behind a ward of light. Turn all three sun mirrors onto it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.
ward.fade: The ward fails by itself. No opening this time.

onEnter.say: The Herald stands behind a ward of light. Turn all three sun mirrors onto it! It fails by itself in 25 seconds.

do.say: Three beams of sunlight meet on the Herald. His ward cracks like a window!
Every obelisk is shattered. Nothing left to hide behind!
